shell_commands: npx prettier --write src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.ts src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md 2>&1

git add src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.ts src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && git status

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(orchestrator): sum usage across all tool rounds in afterModelResponse

Replaces `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` with `accumulateUsage`,
which sums inputTokens/outputTokens/totalTokens across every provider call
in the turn. A round that reports no usage contributes nothing; a turn where
no round reported still passes undefined to the hook.

Closes re-cinq/HALEngine#93.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5 && git status
